independent_checker.method: enumerate every deterministic query set for H<=16

limitations: The theorem is for the oracle/no-guess class; unrestricted algorithms are outside its scope.
The minimax certificate, not a single empirical algorithm, supplies the universal randomized-algorithm quantifier.

negative_control.description: Reveal U before querying; succeeds in one query but violates no-guess.

proof_certificate.deterministic_bound: q distinct queries hit at most q of H inputs
proof_certificate.hidden_input: U uniform on H hidden prefixes
proof_certificate.no_guess_property: before the first hit, the oracle transcript is independent of U
proof_certificate.randomized_extension: a randomized algorithm is a mixture of deterministic algorithms
proof_certificate.worst_case_step: average success <= q/H implies at least one U has success <= q/H

summary: First-hit query thresholds were estimated from 100,000 actual hidden prefix searches per horizon without selecting q from the formula. The measured exponent was 0.455 versus 2log(2)/3=0.462; exhaustive small-H policies and a Yao/symmetry certificate cover every randomized no-guess algorithm.
